patterns.note: Content is primarily centered with generous vertical spacing between distinct full-width sections, often featuring full-bleed media or contrasting background colors to delineate content blocks.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for strong impact and hierarchy, while body text is smaller and highly legible, often accompanied by small, uppercase labels for categorization.

A high-contrast black and white base dominates the site, punctuated by vibrant, saturated accent colors (orange, red, green, blue) within specific graphics, buttons, and animated elements to draw attention.

The site features a highly dynamic scroll experience, with a video hero playing on load, followed by scroll-triggered full-screen geometric animations that transition between major content sections, and Lottie animations for interactive graphics.

Sections alternate between clean white backgrounds and immersive black backgrounds, often incorporating full-bleed video or image content to create distinct visual breaks and moods throughout the page.

technique_notes: The site employs a sophisticated motion system using video for initial hero impact and Lottie animations for complex vector graphics. Scroll-triggered animations, possibly using a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger, are used to create full-screen geometric transitions and reveals as the user scrolls, dynamically changing the background and introducing new content.
Full-bleed media (videos and images) are used extensively to create immersive section backgrounds or hero elements, often paired with centered, high-contrast text overlays for readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-5x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, highly legible body text and occasional uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are applied to interactive elements like buttons and some image containers, maintaining a modern but not overly soft aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: An airy and balanced spacing character is evident, with generous vertical padding between sections and content blocks, creating a sense of openness and allowing elements to breathe.

standout: This site stands out for its exceptionally dynamic and interactive scroll experience, leveraging high-quality video and Lottie animations alongside complex full-screen geometric transitions to create a visually engaging journey rather than a static page. The seamless integration of motion makes the content feel alive and highly polished.
